contradiction_resolution: The finding claims W_24 H^{24}(M_{6,5};Q) is 'not supplied' and is 'of the same difficulty class as residual top-weight claims on M_{g,n}'. This directly contradicts cross-checked THM-0005, which establishes CKgP and tautological Chow ring for M_{g,n} with n <= c(g), where c(6)=5. Since (g,n)=(6,5) satisfies n=5 <= c(6)=5, M_{6,5} lies within the published CKgP range. CKgP implies the cycle class map from the tautological Chow ring to cohomology is surjective in all degrees; tautological classes are of Tate type. Therefore H^{24}(Mbar_{6,5};Q) is spanned by Tate classes Q(-12), and its image W_24 H^{24}(M_{6,5};Q) under restriction to the open is likewise pure Tate. The alleged circularity does not exist: the assumption the finding asserts is 'not supplied' is in fact discharged by THM-0005. This is structurally identical to the retirement of FND-0021, which was retired for contradicting THM-0005's scope over open M_{g,n}. The (6,5) base is not a residual case of the same difficulty as (6,6); it is a discharged base case within the published CKgP range. Web evidence was unavailable (Qwen Responses API HTTP 400); resolution relies entirely on the supplied local corpus (THM-0005, SRC-0002, SRC-0004) which is sufficient to retire the finding.
